answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. What survives to the canyon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The umber holds work receipts rather than names, so the nebula of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
